'''Llewebum''' was a planet located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was home to a species of the [[Llewebum (species)|same name]]. It was a member of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', indicated in [[March]] [[2023]] that Llewebum was validated for a future update of [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]].<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion 2023.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2023-03-25}}</ref>
